description:
From the op-ffg6 audit, 2026-08-13. API-breaking, LOW downstream exposure. ~3 days. Depends on C1, C2, C3.

array_control_vol_and_fluid_component_collections/ minus whatever C2 and C3 already took:
  - the 21 empty-collection / NaN-compare sites (first(), last(), reduce(), partial_cmp())
  - the private-fn signature conversions
  - standalone_fluid_nodes/mod.rs:56 -- stop flattening MatrixError::Singular{col} (src/lib/matrix.rs:39) into
    GenericStringError; propagate the column index. Low effort, real diagnostic gain.

SORT COMPARATORS NEED A DIFFERENT TREATMENT -- do not force Result into them:
  one_d_fluid_array/preprocessing.rs:181, one_d_solid_array/preprocessing.rs:147,
  one_dimension_cartesian_conducting_medium/preprocessing.rs:125
  These are partial_cmp(b).unwrap() inside sort comparators. Prefer total_cmp plus a separate NaN pre-check OUTSIDE the
  sort, rather than threading a Result through a comparator.

Downstream exposure is only new_cylinder, new_block, new_custom_component (~18 call sites).
title: C6 TUAS: array / control-volume core -- remainder after C2 and C3
